original_text: I was charged twice for the same rug and my refund still has not arrived after three weeks.
new_text: Still no refund for the rug I was charged twice for. This is now two months.

original_text: Invoice shows the full price even though the sale discount was applied at the till. I need a corrected invoice for my expenses.
new_text: Got the corrected invoice in the end, thanks.

original_text: They took the deposit and then the whole amount as well. Can someone ring me?
new_text: Not only did nobody call, this month you have taken another payment I never agreed to.

original_text: Prices on the shelf did not match what scanned at the till, had to get the manager over.
new_text: Shelf labels were wrong again on Saturday, same story at the till.

original_text: My card was debited but the order shows as unpaid.
new_text: Order is still marked unpaid and I keep getting reminder emails.

original_text: Delivery fee was added twice at checkout. It was refunded quickly once I called.
new_text: Great service this time, the sofa bed is perfect.

original_text: Finance option at checkout quoted 0% and my statement shows interest.
new_text: The interest was reversed and the statement is correct now.

original_text: Charged for delivery on an order that qualified for free shipping.
new_text: Shipping charge was credited back within the week.

original_text: Receipt total did not match what left my account.
new_text: All sorted, the difference was refunded.

original_text: Voucher code was accepted but the discount never came off the total.
new_text: You honoured the voucher after I emailed, appreciated.

original_text: The sofa arrived two weeks late and the driver left it outside in the rain.
new_text: This order came on the day you said it would. Much better.

original_text: Still waiting for the dining table I ordered in August. No update, no tracking.
new_text: It is November and the table from August is still not here.

original_text: Courier turned up a day after the slot I paid extra for.
new_text: Paid for a timed slot again and again the driver missed it.

original_text: Promised by Friday, came the following Thursday. I took a day off work for nothing.
new_text: New order, same problem, except this time it was nearly three weeks overdue.

original_text: Bed frame was ten days late.
new_text: Second order turned up bang on time.

original_text: Delivery date was moved three times.
new_text: Lovely lamp, very happy with it.

original_text: Click and collect order was not ready when I arrived, had to come back the next day.
new_text: Collection was ready and waiting when I walked in.

original_text: Waited in all day and nobody came.
new_text: Once again I stayed home for a delivery that did not show up.

original_text: Wardrobe came with a cracked door panel, box looked like it had been dropped, and I am still waiting for a replacement panel.
new_text: Replacement door panel arrived and was fitted, wardrobe looks fine now.

original_text: Mirror was smashed when I opened the box. Third time I am writing about this.
new_text: The replacement mirror turned up cracked as well.

original_text: Manager was dismissive when I raised the damaged table, said it was not his department. I still need it sorted.
new_text: Still stuck with the damaged table, and now I am told the warranty has run out because of the delay.

original_text: Chest of drawers arrived with a dented corner.
new_text: They swapped the dented drawers within a few days.

original_text: Glass shelf was chipped out of the box.
new_text: Friendly driver this time.

original_text: The new app keeps logging me out before I can claim my points.
new_text: Since the update I stay logged in and my points are all there.

original_text: I have reset my password four times and still cannot sign in to the rewards thing on my phone.
new_text: I gave up on the app, still cannot sign in.

original_text: App says my account does not exist, but I have been a member for three years. Nobody has replied to my email about it.
new_text: Now it has locked me out completely and wiped my points balance.

original_text: Nice store, helpful people. Only gripe is the loyalty app asking me to log in every single time.
new_text: No longer asks for my password every visit, much better.

original_text: The app throws me out every time I open the rewards tab.
new_text: The store smelled lovely, nice candles.
